title: Verso - Expedition 33 Character Guide & Lore
description: Verso in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - who they are, when they join the party, their unique mechanic, relationships and role in the story.

sections.title: Who They Are
sections.content:
Verso joins in Act 2 at the Sinister Cave and shifts the party's damage model toward marks. His Perfection Rank climbs from D to S as he fights, and Marking Shot sets up mark-dependent skills on allies.

Joins: Sinister Cave (Act 2)

sections.title: Background
sections.content:
Contains story spoilers - stop here if you have not finished the game.

The Verso you recruit is a painted copy of the real Verso Dessendre, who died in a fire at the family home. The Canvas itself was painted into existence by that real Verso, and holds the last surviving fragment of his soul. See world lore.

sections.title: Playable or NPC
sections.content:
Their defining mechanic is Perfection Rank (D to S).

Party role: DPS / Mark Support.

Skills, Pictos and stat allocation are covered on the Verso build guide - this page is the character, not the kit.

In the party tier list they sit at S.
